evidence.excerpt: To address this gap, we present EgoWitness, a benchmark for instance-level spatial memory and reasoning in egocentric video.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Its 8,453 human-verified questions span approximately 324 hours of week-long and short-horizon recordings and test seven abilities, from recognizing an object or room to recalling who saw it and reasoning about room visits.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Among twelve direct vision-language models (VLMs), open-weight models reach at most 46.97% accuracy, and none exceeds 35% on identifying who saw an object last.
